bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first study tracker for CSIR-UGC NET Physical Sciences.
bundle.longDescription: A Windows desktop study tracker for CSIR-UGC NET Physical Sciences. Phase 4 adds a persisted focus timer and study-session history alongside the official-source syllabus catalog, per-topic progress, planning settings, and exam countdown. Timer and session data stay in a local SQLite database, with restart and sleep recovery that exclude time when the app was not actively tracking.
